import os
program_dir='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u041/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(program_dir, exist_ok=True)
def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    sep=next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v==5 for v in row))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid[sep+1:]]
    # Find connected components above the separator; choose the rightmost by bounding-box center.
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(sep):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color in (0,5) or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                rr,cc=stack.pop(); cells.append((rr,cc))
                for nr,nc in ((rr-1,cc),(rr+1,cc),(rr,cc-1),(rr,cc+1)):
                    if 0<=nr<sep and 0<=nc<w and (nr,nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc]==color:
                        seen.add((nr,nc)); stack.append((nr,nc))
            comps.append((cells,color))
    cells,color=max(comps,key=lambda x:max(c for r,c in x[0]))
    # Position above the lower object, aligned by left edges of bounding boxes.
    bottom=[(r-sep-1,c) for r in range(sep+1,h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=0]
    br0=min(r for r,c in bottom); bc0=min(c for r,c in bottom)
    tr0=min(r for r,c in cells); tc0=min(c for r,c in cells)
    for r,c in cells:
        rr=br0-(max(x[0] for x in cells)-tr0+1)+(r-tr0)
        cc=bc0+(c-tc0)
        out[rr][cc]=color
    return out
path=os.path.join(program_dir,'task-c6abf7c7.py')
source='''def transform(grid):\n    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])\n    sep=next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v==5 for v in row))\n    out=[row[:] for row in grid[sep+1:]]\n    seen=set(); comps=[]\n    for r in range(sep):\n        for c in range(w):\n            color=grid[r][c]\n            if color in (0,5) or (r,c) in seen: continue\n            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]\n            while stack:\n                rr,cc=stack.pop(); cells.append((rr,cc))\n                for nr,nc in ((rr-1,cc),(rr+1,cc),(rr,cc-1),(rr,cc+1)):\n                    if 0<=nr<sep and 0<=nc<w and (nr,nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc]==color:\n                        seen.add((nr,nc)); stack.append((nr,nc))\n            comps.append((cells,color))\n    cells,color=max(comps,key=lambda x:max(c for r,c in x[0]))\n    bottom=[(r-sep-1,c) for r in range(sep+1,h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=0]\n    br0=min(r for r,c in bottom); bc0=min(c for r,c in bottom)\n    tr0=min(r for r,c in cells); tc0=min(c for r,c in cells)\n    th=max(r for r,c in cells)-tr0+1\n    for r,c in cells:\n        rr=br0-th+(r-tr0); cc=bc0+(c-tc0)\n        out[rr][cc]=color\n    return out\n'''
open(path,'w').write(source)
path
